title: Porterhouse with Sweet Potato Mash and Broccolini
desc: A quick Sunday steak night: porterhouse, a fist of sweet potato mash and broccolini.

portions.J: 2 steaks (2 × 200 g), a fist of mash, broccolini
portions.P: 1 steak (200 g), a smaller fist of mash, broccolini

steps.title: Bring the steak to room temp
steps.text: Take the steaks out 20 minutes before cooking. Pat dry and season well.

steps.title: Boil the sweet potato
steps.text: Peel, chop and simmer the sweet potato until soft.

steps.title: Cook the steak
steps.text: Rub with oil and cook on a very hot pan or barbecue, about 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium rare.

steps.title: Rest and finish
steps.text: Rest the steak 5 minutes. Steam the broccolini and mash the sweet potato with the butter.

notes: Fat trimmed off the steak saves about 80 kcal per 200 g.
